Key.English: Sync to one or more objects, such as a flagpole or an officer. Players at those objects can recruit AI soldiers into their own group, up to the group size set here. Recruits are not part of any AI Commander's forces. With player saves on, they are saved with the player who recruited them.
Class names of the soldiers players can recruit, separated by commas. Leave empty for up to eight common infantry roles of each player's own faction.
How good recruits are. Game default leaves them at the skill the game gives any new soldier (set by the difficulty settings); the other choices set every recruit's skill to that level.
The most men a group can have, players included, before recruiting stops. Two players in one group with this at 8 can recruit 6.
